reviews.t: Great for fine hair with less damage than a curling iron.
reviews.x: Curls very fine hair and holds curl longer. My hair is very fine and stick straight. In order for me to get any kind of volume, I have to use curlers or a curling iron, but both damage my hair. These work for me and are not as damaging. I use long hair clips to hold them, not the holders they come with.

I have been using the Caruso Steam System for probably over twenty years.  I have gone through I think three base units.  So great that Amazon allows you to buy the steam unit or the curlers individually.  Does not dry my hair out like the old electric curlers used to.  Highly recommend.
I have fine,thin hair and these rollers work wonders on it. After I leave the rollers in, I blow dry my hair for a couple of minutes to make it smoother and less curly.

The Caruso Steam Unit works great.  Very quick to heat up.  I fill it up with water to the line that it shows and within seconds, it is ready to use.  I bought (2) different sizes of rollers to use.  So, buying the steam unit seperate allowed me to buy what I needed and not have a lot of unused rollers.

I've bought so many of these...it's the only hair curling system I like. They don't damage your hair. The only issue I ever have with these is the clogging up or failing to steam. I still can't remember if you're suppose to use salt in the water or not...it's been awhile since I've used them again. The unit itself is great tho. The only one I would consider using to curl my hair. I've been using Caruso for 25 years.

Would not use any other unit or type of heating for my hair.  This makes the curles stay in and is so easy to use!  I had lots of rollers, the original steamer finally broke (it was dropped by one of my granddaughters) so I just bought a new one!  Takes up a lot less space than the electric roller sets and much, much easier to use!

By the time my last curler is in, I'm taking the first ones out.  My curl is softer, my hair less damaged, and the curl lasts longer than electric or overnight curlers. reviews.t: I am very happy with my purchase and like the steamer much better ...
reviews.x: I had a Caruso Steamer years ago and used it until it quit. I received a different curler as a gift but missed the steamer. When I found out I could purchase only the steamer, I did. I am very happy with my purchase and like the steamer much better for curling my hair than just a plain heat curler.

I have used this product for many years. It has an excellent life for the unit itself. I have only had to replace it every 6 or 7 years which I think is good. Quick and easy hair setting especially if you're in a hurry.

reviews.t: I love the Caruso Steam Unit
reviews.x: I gave been trying to find one of the steamers without the rollers. A friend told me to check on Amazon. However another was ordered tooabd I need to find out how to send it back.
Was completely upset that I didn't get the product.  After I wrote about it it was shipped immediately.  I have been using these rollers for years and love them.
Caruso Steam roller set and steamer are the best that was ever made for fine or medium and even thick hair. I would never use a different brand.

claims.text: Many reviewers love this steam unit and say it works great, heats up quickly, and is easy to use.
Reviewers praise it for being gentler on hair than electric curlers, leaving hair soft and shiny without drying or damaging it.
Several reviewers appreciate being able to buy just the steam unit since they already own plenty of rollers.
Some reviewers report reliability problems, with units failing after only a few uses or barely emitting steam.
A few reviewers mention clogging or failing to steam as an occasional issue over long-term use.
